title: Havne plugin manifest
description: A Havne plugin's manifest (formats 1 to 3, ADR-0052 and ADR-0066): a folder's manifest.json, or a packed plugin, one file holding the manifest and its files under "files". Format 2 adds the conversation tier: a WebAssembly module that asks an ECU within the services its manifest declares. Format 3 adds the publisher, which a plugin with the conversation tier names. A folder's data files take this schema's #/$defs/dataFile. Map this schema to your files in your editor's settings: the loader refuses a "$schema" key, as it refuses every key it doesn't know.
$comment: The loader (core/src/plugin_manifest.cpp, core/src/plugin_conversation.cpp, core/src/plugin_publisher.cpp, core/src/plugin_operations.cpp) is the truth; tests/schema_keys.py keeps each object's keys equal to its only_keys sets, and the signals are signal-file.schema.json's. The loader alone checks: "havne_plugin" and a data file's "havne_signals" as the first key; the sizes (1 MiB a manifest or a data file, 16 MiB a package) and JSON's rules; lengths in UTF-8 bytes; whole numbers written with no fraction or exponent; which form a manifest is ("files" only in a packed plugin and required there, "fixtures" only in a folder's); every packed file in a variant, and every variant's file in "files" or in the folder; "requires.core" no later than the core reading it; a year range's first year no later than its last; variant ids given once each; the profile name made from "name" at most 63 characters; a data file's signals naming the manifest's ECUs, "extends" in a variant's first file only, a key once in each data file, a variant's merged signals passing every rule of a signal file (at most 1024, one signal file of at most 1 MiB written out); everything signal-file.schema.json leaves to its loader; the conversation's ECUs each one of "ecus"; a service given once; a security level's ECU one of the conversation's, a level once for an ECU, and service 27 declared with the level's sub-function and the next; the code's file a binary file in a packed plugin's "files" or a file in the folder, at most 1 MiB, its SHA-256 the one stated, and a module the sandbox takes (one memory of a fixed size up to 16 pages, no import, no start function, the guest ABI's six exports); every binary file named by the manifest; the publisher's texts with no control character (the terms keep line feeds and tabs) and no character that shows as nothing or moves the text around it; an operation's ECU one of the conversation's, its level one the conversation's security declares for that ECU, and service 22 declared for its identifiers; an operation's id, an identifier's DID and a step's name given once each; a step's address and its range's end within its address bytes and its size within its size bytes; no two steps sharing an address, and at most 64 MiB of memory in one operation; a page named once and by no variant, its file at most 82,400 bytes as read and as core writes it, a packed one a member of "files" (64 data and binary files beside the pages), and its page and cells the layout file's rules (havne-cli layout check, ADR-0057).

havne_plugin.title: Format
havne_plugin.description: The manifest format's version, and the manifest's first key. This Havne reads formats 1 to 3; the conversation tier and a binary file are format 2's, the publisher format 3's, and a plugin names a core that reads its format in requires.core (format 2: 0.9.0 or later; format 3: 0.9.1 or later).

id.title: Plugin id
id.description: 1 to 31 of a-z, 0-9 and -, a letter or digit at each end. Each variant's profile is plugin.<id>.<variant>.

name.title: Name
name.description: The plugin's name, 1 to 63 bytes with at least one letter or digit. A recording of a variant names its signal file by it.

version.title: Version
version.description: The plugin's own version, X.Y.Z: each 0 to 65535 with no leading zero, 15 characters at most.

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.description: The first 32 hex digits, in lower case, of the SHA-256 of the signal file the plugin was first made from. Havne writes it when it wraps a signal file and keeps it through every change; a package with the same id and the same lineage is a version of the same plugin. Leave it out of a plugin written by hand.

requires.title: Requires
requires.description: What the plugin needs to load.

core.title: Core version
core.description: The oldest Havne core that reads the plugin, X.Y.Z.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: What the plugin holds: "data" (signal files), which every plugin lists, from format 2 "conversation" (a module that asks, described by "conversation"), and in format 3 "operation" (plans Havne runs against a module, listed by "operations"), which needs the conversation tier beside it. A plugin naming another tier is refused.

match.title: Match
match.description: The cars the plugin proposes itself for by their VIN, at most 32 rules. A match only proposes: the user picks the variant.

ecus.description: The modules the data files' signals read, named by id; a data file declares none of its own. The base set's count toward 32 in all, of one ID width.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: 1 to 32 named lists of data files, each list merged by signal key at load (a later file's signal replaces an earlier one's in its place, and adds the rest).

fixtures.title: Fixtures
fixtures.description: A folder's value-fixture files, at most 16, which havne-cli plugins check runs (plugin-fixtures.schema.json). A packed plugin carries none.

files.title: Files
files.description: A packed plugin's files, at most 80, each by the path the manifest names it by: a data file, in format 2 a binary file (an object with "kind"), or a page the manifest's "pages" names. A folder's manifest takes none.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: The Dashboard pages the plugin carries, 1 to 16, each a page file (#/$defs/pageFile) by its path: a file beside the data in a folder, a member of "files" in a packed plugin.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: The operation tier's plans (format 3, ADR-0066), 1 to 8, each id once.

not.$comment: A packed plugin carries no fixtures, and only a packed one has files

allOf.$comment: The conversation tier and "conversation" come together, in format 2 or 3
The operation tier and "operations" come together, in format 3, beside the conversation tier
The publisher is format 3's, and format 3 names it with the conversation tier
Havne checks no signature: a publisher signs beside the plugin, and its user checks the signature with their own tool

path.title: Path
path.description: A path in the package: relative, forward slashes, no empty, "." or ".." part, 1 to 127 printable ASCII characters but backslash and colon.

years.title: Model years
years.description: The first and the last model year, 1980 to 2039, inclusive.

match.title: Match rule
match.description: Manufacturer codes, and optionally the model years, a car's VIN must show.

wmi.title: Manufacturer codes
wmi.description: 1 to 64 world manufacturer identifiers: a VIN's first 3 characters, or 6 (the first 3 and the 12th to 14th) where the third is 9. Upper case, no I, O or Q.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: One variant: its data files in order, merged by signal key, and optionally the model years it's for.

id.title: Variant id
id.description: 1 to 24 of a-z, 0-9 and -, a letter or digit at each end. Its profile is plugin.<plugin id>.<variant id>.

files.title: Files
files.description: The variant's data files, 1 to 64, each once. Only the first may extend a set.

dataFile.title: Plugin data file
dataFile.description: A plugin's data file: a signal file whose signals name the manifest's ECUs by id and which declares none of its own. Its name and source are optional, the manifest's being the plugin's.

havne_signals.title: Format
havne_signals.description: The signal-file format's version, and the file's first key. This Havne reads formats 1 to 3: a variant is read at the newest of its files' formats whole, and a plugin with a format 2 or 3 file names a core that reads it in requires.core. A variant that holds a format 3 file is a format 3 set, so a format 1 or 2 file's signal named as one of the extended set's is refused there: give every file of the variant format 3.

name.title: Name
name.description: The data file's own name, 1 to 63 bytes, for its reader: a variant's signal file takes the plugin's.

extends.description: A built-in set the variant adds to, only in a variant's first file: "obd2" in format 1.

needs.description: Format 3: the keys this file's expressions read that another file provides. A key another file of the same variant defines is met there; what is left is the variant's need, met when the variant is read together with a plugin that provides it.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: The file's signals, each key once. A variant's files' signals merged hold 1 to 1024.

packedFile.title: Packed file
packedFile.description: A member of a packed plugin's "files": a binary file when it has "kind", a data file when it has "havne_signals", else a page.

pageFile.title: Page file
pageFile.description: A Dashboard page the plugin carries: an ADR-0057 layout file of one page for one form, with no signal files to name (the plugin is the file its key: references need). The envelope is core's; the page and its cells are the layout file's rules, and keys this schema doesn't list are kept.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Format 3: who stands behind the plugin and on what terms, which a person reads before consenting to a plugin that talks to a module. Each text is UTF-8, its length in bytes.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: How to reach the publisher (a web page or an address), 1 to 255 bytes.

license.title: License
license.description: The plugin's license, 1 to 63 bytes, an SPDX identifier where there is one.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The terms a person reads whole before consenting, 1 byte to 64 KiB; line feeds and tabs are kept.

binaryFile.title: Binary file
binaryFile.description: A packed plugin's binary file (format 2): its bytes as RFC 4648 base64 with the standard alphabet, padded, with no white space and the padding's unused bits zero.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the bytes are: "wasm", a WebAssembly module.

base64.title: Bytes
base64.description: The file's bytes, at most 1 MiB of them.

hexByte.title: Byte
hexByte.description: A byte as two hex digits, the letters in upper case.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: A plan Havne runs against one module (format 3, ADR-0066): its steps in order. A plan is data: Havne derives its class (a read, when every step is a "read" or an "upload"), how many sessions it unlocks in and its image's size from the steps, and refuses by name a kind or a step it doesn't run.

id.title: ID
id.description: The plan's id, 1 to 31 of a-z, 0-9 and -, a letter or digit at each end; once among the operations.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the plan does: "dump" copies a module's memory to a file.

title.title: Title
title.description: The plan's name for a person, 1 to 63 bytes, with no control character.

ecu.title: ECU
ecu.description: The module, one of the conversation's "ecus".

level.title: Level
level.description: The security-access level the plan reads under, two hex digits: one the conversation's "security" declares for the ECU.

ident.title: Identification
ident.description: The identifiers read before and after the copy and kept in its record, at most 8, each DID once; the conversation declares service 22 for them.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The plan's steps in order, 1 to 64, each name once, no two sharing an address, 64 MiB of memory in all.

operationIdent.title: Identification
operationIdent.description: An identifier a dump reads with service 22 and keeps in its record, and what it tells of the module.

did.title: DID
did.description: The data identifier, four hex digits.

role.title: Role
role.description: What the identifier names: the module's hardware, its software or its base calibration.

operationStep.title: Step
operationStep.description: One range of memory and how it is read: "read" asks it chunk by chunk (service 23), "upload" has the module send it block by block (services 35, 36 and 37). The loader also holds the address and the range's end to the address's bytes, and the size to the size's.

name.title: Name
name.description: The range's name in the copy's record, 1 to 31 of a-z, 0-9 and -, a letter or digit at each end; once among the steps.

session.title: Session
session.description: The diagnostic session the step runs in.

address.title: Address
address.description: The range's first address, 2 to 8 hex digits in pairs.

bytes.title: Bytes
bytes.description: The range's size in bytes, 1 to 67108864.

address_bytes.title: Address bytes
address_bytes.description: How many bytes the request's address takes, 1 to 4.

size_bytes.title: Size bytes
size_bytes.description: How many bytes the request's size takes, 1 to 4.

chunk.title: Chunk
chunk.description: A read's bytes for each request, 1 to 4094; an upload takes none (the module names its block).

dfi.title: Data format identifier
dfi.description: An upload's data format, "00" (neither compressed nor encrypted) alone; a read takes none.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: The conversation tier (format 2, ADR-0066): the module that asks, the ECUs it talks to and everything it may cause to be sent. Havne sends nothing for a module that its manifest doesn't declare here, and nothing outside the tier's own ceiling whatever is declared: the extended session, tester present, security access and reads.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: The most instructions one call into the module may run, 1 to 1000000 (the default).

ecus.title: ECUs
ecus.description: The modules the code talks to, 1 to 32 of the manifest's "ecus" by id, each once.

services.title: Services
services.description: The services the code may cause to be sent, 1 to 16, each once.

security.title: Security levels
security.description: The security-access levels the code computes a key for, at most 32.

code.title: Code
code.description: The conversation's module: a WebAssembly file of at most 1 MiB, and the SHA-256 of its bytes, which the loader compares.

file.description: The module's path: a binary file of a packed plugin's "files", or a file in the folder.

sha256.title: SHA-256
sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the module's bytes, 64 hex digits in lower case.

service.title: Service
service.description: A service the code may cause to be sent. The services whose sub-functions differ in what they do (10, 27, 2C, 3E) are declared with the sub-functions; the reads (19, 22, 2A) without.

sid.title: Service ID
sid.description: The service, two hex digits: 10 (session control), 19 (read DTC information), 22 (read data by identifier), 27 (security access), 2A (read data by periodic identifier), 2C (dynamically define data identifier), 3E (tester present).

sub.title: Sub-functions
sub.description: The sub-functions declared, 1 to 14, each once: 03 for 10; 00 for 3E; 01 and 03 for 2C; 01 to 7E but 5F and 60 for 27, a level's seed request and the key request after it.

securityLevel.title: Security level
securityLevel.description: A security-access level the code computes a key for, on one of the conversation's ECUs. Havne asks the seed, hands it to the module, and sends the key the module gives, holding both to the lengths here; the services declare 27 with this level's sub-function and the next.

ecu.title: ECU
ecu.description: The module, one of the conversation's "ecus".

level.title: Level
level.description: The seed request's sub-function, two hex digits: odd, 01 to 7D, never 5F. The key request's is the next.

seed_bytes.title: Seed length
seed_bytes.description: The seed's length in bytes, 1 to 255.

key_bytes.title: Key length
key_bytes.description: The key's length in bytes, 1 to 58.

delay_ms.title: Delay
delay_ms.description: The least wait after a key the ECU refused, in milliseconds: 1000 to 3600000, 10000 when left out.

key_window_ms.title: Key window
key_window_ms.description: How long the module has to give the key after its seed, in milliseconds: 50 to 4000, 1000 when left out.
